text:
```yaml
name: Weekly Repo Status - Feb 20–27, 2026

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0' # Runs at midnight on Sunday

jobs:
  repo_status:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Generate repo status report
        run: npx generate-repo-status --start-date "2026-02-20" --end-date "2026-02-27"

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'GitHub Copilot'
          git config --global user.email 'copilot@microsoft.com'
          git add .
          git commit -m "Weekly Repo Status - Feb 20–27, 2026"
          git push origin main
```
